Functions $h$ and $f$ are graphed.

![Function h is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, 5), moves downward to (negative 2, negative 1), moves upward through (negative 1, 1) to (0, 3), moves horizontally to the right to (3, 3), moves downward and ends at (4, 0).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/f3d0f694c44c5f91831958552e6dbbae55df1780) ![Function f is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, negative 2), moves upward to (negative 2, 0), moves downward to an open circle at (negative 1, 0), moves upward to (2, 4), moves downward to (3, 0), moves upward and ends at (4, 2).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/9b509b9fb762428632a057032b912ba9f21ee732)

**Find $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to -1}\dfrac{h(x)}{f(x)}$.**

[[☃ radio 1]]
